description.value: SABOOS Bread Factory Ltd. is a North Vancouver artisan bakery and specialty food shop producing Persian flatbreads, sourdough loaves, Lebanese-style baklavas, and fresh cream puffs daily with no additives or preservatives. Beyond baked goods, the shop carries a broad selection of Middle Eastern and Mediterranean provisions including housemade hummus, halva, dairy products, imported olives, premium olive oils, and spices — making it a practical stop for cyclists looking to restock quality pantry staples. The combination of fresh bread and ready-to-eat items like hummus makes it a notable provisioning option in North Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched from saboos.ca and confirms an active business. The contact page provides a phone number (604-770-4140) and address (118-930 W. 1st Street North Vancouver BC) not present in OSM tags. The product listing confirms a broad range of food items — dairy, oils, hummus, spices — supporting the Groceries category alongside the bakery primary use. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or any cycle-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'SABOOS BREAD'; website consistently uses the fuller legal name 'SABOOS Bread Factory Ltd.' — minor discrepancy, OSM name retained per rules.
OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website contact page only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active business confirmed by a functioning website with product listings, contact info, and a 2026 copyright notice. Useful to touring cyclists as a fresh bread and specialty grocery provisioning stop in North Vancouver.
